collection.description: A thoughtful teen asks whether people can live good lives without believing in gods or spirits.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A thoughtful teen asks whether people can live good lives without believing in gods or spirits.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The teen hears examples of ethical action rooted in many beliefs.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Their explanations disagree, but all affirm the teen's place in the village.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The teen decides that uncertainty itself can be honest.
